message:
fire AfterApply for env-only flags (#600)

A flag that gets its value purely from an env variable never shows up in
ctx.Path: Reset() applies the env value straight to the target and the
parse loop has nothing to record. The main applyHook walks ctx.Path so
it skips those flags, and applyHookToDefaultFlags only looked at flags
with a default tag, so the hook was silently dropped (reported in #596).

Loosen the default-flag pass to also match flags that have at least one
env set. The 'already handled' guard on ctx.values stays, so anything
that did show up on the parse path is still skipped (and the hook still
fires exactly once).

Closes #596

Signed-off-by: Charlie Tonneslan <cst0520@gmail.com>

pr.title: fire AfterApply for env-only flags
pr.body:
Closes #596.

Reset() applies env vars to the target field directly and never adds the flag to ctx.Path, so the main applyHook loop walks past them. applyHookToDefaultFlags was the catch-all for that case, but it only matched flags with a default tag. Flags whose value comes purely from \`env:"…"\` had nowhere to fire from.

Loosen the second pass to also match flags with at least one env var set. ctx.values is still the dedup guard, so anything actually parsed off argv or supplied by a resolver still goes through the main loop and only fires once.

Test added that fails on master and passes with this change.

linkedIssues.title: AfterApply hook doesn't work for environment-provided parameters
linkedIssues.body:
Hello! Thank you for your hard work, your library is just perfect for building conveniently configurable cli applications. I love using it. However, I've encountered a problem.

In my application, a custom parameter with an AfterApply hook can be provided via:
1. argv
2. environment variable
3. json config

The hook isn't called in the second case. A minimal reproduction script is provided below. It creates a temp directory, main.go there and installs kong, and then runs the app 3 times with different parameter suppliment methods.

```bash
#!/bin/bash

tempdir=$(mktemp -d)
echo "entering temp dir: $tempdir"
cd "$tempdir"

cat <<'EOF' >main.go
package main

import (
  "fmt"
  "github.com/alecthomas/kong"
)

type CustomField string

func (c CustomField) AfterApply() error {
  fmt.Println(c)
  return nil
}

type CLI struct {
  Config kong.ConfigFlag `name:"config"`
  CustomField CustomField `name:"custom-field" env:"CUSTOM_FIELD" required:""`
}

func main() {
  var cli CLI
  kong.Parse(&cli, kong.Configuration(kong.JSON))
}
EOF

go mod init repro
go get github.com/alecthomas/kong@v1.15.0

go run main.go --custom-field running-with-cli-parameter
CUSTOM_FIELD=running-with-env-parameter go run main.go
go run main.go --config <(echo '{"custom_field": "running-with-json-config"}')
```

The actual output:
```
entering temp dir: /var/folders/hv/2d98p0sj72vbvcps49zpm7yh0000gq/T/tmp.2FJWWmMOrS
go: creating new go.mod: module repro
go: to add module requirements and sums:
        go mod tidy
go: added github.com/alecthomas/kong v1.15.0
running-with-cli-parameter
running-with-json-config
```

The output expected by me:
```
entering temp dir: /var/folders/hv/2d98p0sj72vbvcps49zpm7yh0000gq/T/tmp.2FJWWmMOrS
go: creating new go.mod: module repro
go: to add module requirements and sums:
        go mod tidy
go: added github.com/alecthomas/kong v1.15.0
running-with-cli-parameter
running-with-env-parameter <------ this line
running-with-json-config
```

explanation.what: kong.go の applyHookToDefaultFlags を修正。従来は `!flag.HasDefault` の場合に continue してスキップしていたが、env タグで環境変数を持つフラグ(atLeastOneEnvSet(flag.Tag.Envs))も対象に含めるよう条件を変更した。ctx.values に値が記録済み(既に main の applyHook ループで処理済み)かどうかのガードはそのまま維持し、二重発火は防いでいる。kong_test.go に環境変数のみで値を供給したフラグで AfterApply が呼ばれることを検証する回帰テストを追加。
explanation.why: PR本文とリンクされた issue #596 が説明する通り、環境変数だけで値が供給されたフラグは Reset() が直接ターゲットに値をセットするため ctx.Path に載らず、ctx.Path を辿るメインの applyHook ループでは素通りしてしまう。default タグを持つフラグの取りこぼしを拾うための第二パスである applyHookToDefaultFlags も、これまでは HasDefault のみを見ていたため env のみのフラグの AfterApply フックが静かに呼ばれずに終わっていた不具合を修正する。

highlights.note: !flag.HasDefault && !atLeastOneEnvSet(flag.Tag.Envs) で判定するよう変更した条件分岐
